title: Boys Over Flowers
description: An ordinary girl from a poor family enters an elite school and clashes with a group of arrogant rich boys who turn her world upside down.

title: Business Proposal
description: An office employee accidentally goes on a blind date with her company’s CEO while pretending to be someone else, leading to a series of hilarious misunderstandings.

title: I Am Not a Robot
description: A man with a rare allergy to humans falls in love with a woman pretending to be a robot to help him.

title: True Beauty
description: A high school girl insecure about her looks becomes popular through makeup but fears someone will discover her true self.
